scope: four-case preparation pilot; deliberately selected failure/contrast cases, not a broad benchmark

noise_hysteresis.noise_estimator: median of axis-wise normal-scaled neighbor-difference MAD / sqrt(2)
noise_hysteresis.noise_scope: core patch; scalar, not a spatially varying noise map
noise_hysteresis.propagation_scope: core patch only; no gap filling

contrast_diagnostic.rule: Trilinear intensity at reference curve versus median of six axial neighbors at +/- 3 voxels; boundary points excluded
